metadata.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions API. Drop-in replacement for the OpenAI API — use any OpenAI SDK or client to access Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen, Mistral, and all OpenAI models (GPT-5, GPT-4o, o3) through fal. Powered by OpenRouter.

RouterOpenaiV1ChatCompletionsInput.description: OpenAI-format request. This endpoint is an OpenAI-compatible passthrough to OpenRouter's Chat Completions API: the request body follows the OpenAI Chat Completions wire format and is forwarded with minimal normalization (usage accounting is enabled, and when a fal caller id is available, a privacy-preserving hash of it replaces any caller-supplied `user`); the response follows the OpenAI wire format except that `usage`, when returned non-null, is replaced with fal's accounting shape (`prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, `total_tokens`, `cost`, `prompt_tokens_details`; fields may be null). When `stream` is true on a synchronous invocation, the response is delivered as server-sent events instead of a single JSON object. Authoritative behavior, including which fields each model accepts, is defined by OpenRouter's implementation (https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference); see also the OpenAI Chat Completions API reference (https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat). Any field accepted there is accepted here, subject to the normalization above.

RouterOpenaiV1ChatCompletionsOutput.description: OpenAI-format response. This endpoint is an OpenAI-compatible passthrough to OpenRouter's Chat Completions API: the request body follows the OpenAI Chat Completions wire format and is forwarded with minimal normalization (usage accounting is enabled, and when a fal caller id is available, a privacy-preserving hash of it replaces any caller-supplied `user`); the response follows the OpenAI wire format except that `usage`, when returned non-null, is replaced with fal's accounting shape (`prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, `total_tokens`, `cost`, `prompt_tokens_details`; fields may be null). When `stream` is true on a synchronous invocation, the response is delivered as server-sent events instead of a single JSON object. Authoritative behavior, including which fields each model accepts, is defined by OpenRouter's implementation (https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference); see also the OpenAI Chat Completions API reference (https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat).

metadata.description: Run any video-capable LLM with fal. Analyze, summarize, and understand video files using Gemini (Google) models. Supports mp4, mpeg, mov, webm, and YouTube links. Powered by OpenRouter.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Prompt to be used for the video processing

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: System prompt to provide context or instructions to the model
examples: Please look at the videos in order and answer the question.

web_search_options.description: Options for web search (engine, result limits, domain filters, ...). Ignored unless enable_web_search is true.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Should reasoning be the part of the final answer.

video_urls.title: Video Urls
video_urls.description: List of URLs or data URIs of video files to process. Supported formats: mp4, mpeg, mov, webm. For Google Gemini on AI Studio, YouTube links are also supported. Mutually exclusive with video_url.

enable_web_search.title: Enable Web Search
enable_web_search.description: Give the model access to real-time web information via OpenRouter's web search server tool. When enabled, the model decides when to search and may search multiple times per request. Search costs are charged in addition to token usage.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: This sets the upper limit for the number of tokens the model can generate in response. It won't produce more than this limit. The maximum value is the context length minus the prompt length.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: This setting influences the variety in the model's responses. Lower values lead to more predictable and typical responses, while higher values encourage more diverse and less common responses. At 0, the model always gives the same response for a given input.

model.title: Model
model.description: Name of the model to use. Charged based on actual token usage.

output.title: Output
examples:
that's the way I look at it and I don't know what you would say. Sooner or later the child gets run over.
They seem to be too local, too provincial.

WebSearchOptions.title: WebSearchOptions
WebSearchOptions.description: Options for the OpenRouter ``openrouter:web_search`` server tool.

max_characters.title: Max Characters
max_characters.description: Exact maximum characters of content per result (1-100,000). Applies to the Exa engine; ignored with native provider search. Takes precedence over search_context_size when both are set.

excluded_domains.title: Excluded Domains
excluded_domains.description: Exclude results from these domains. Supported by Exa and some native providers (not OpenAI or Google native search).

max_uses.title: Max Uses
max_uses.description: Maximum number of searches the model may perform in a single request. Once reached, further search calls return an error result instead of executing. With native provider search, forwarded only to Anthropic; other native providers ignore it.

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum results per search call (1-25). Applies to the Exa engine; ignored with native provider search. Defaults to 5.

allowed_domains.title: Allowed Domains
allowed_domains.description: Limit results to these domains. Supported by Exa and most native providers (not Google native search).

max_total_results.title: Max Total Results
max_total_results.description: Maximum total results across all search calls in a single request. Useful for controlling cost and context size in agentic loops.

search_context_size.title: Search Context Size
search_context_size.description: How much content to retrieve per result. For Exa: low=5K, medium=15K, high=30K characters per result; when omitted, Exa picks adaptively (~2-4K per result). Ignored with native provider search. Overridden by max_characters when both are set.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Search engine to use. 'auto' uses native provider search when available and falls back to Exa. 'native' prefers the provider's built-in web search (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Perplexity), falling back to Exa for models without native support. 'exa' always uses Exa's search API.

user_location.description: Approximate user location for location-biased results. Only supported by native provider search; ignored by Exa.

WebSearchUserLocation.title: WebSearchUserLocation
WebSearchUserLocation.description:
Approximate user location to bias web search results geographically.

Only honored by native provider search; ignored by the Exa engine.
All fields are optional.

metadata.description: Run any decision model with fal, powered by OpenRouter.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Identifier for grouping related decision requests.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: Questions keyed by caller-defined IDs. Each question is evaluated independently against the same state.

refund_requested.instructions: Is the customer requesting a refund?

criteria.shipping: Delivery status, delays, or lost packages

department.instructions: Which team should handle this request?

state.title: State
state.description: Text or structured JSON content for the model to evaluate.
examples: My card was charged twice. Please refund the duplicate.

criteria.description: Optional descriptions clarifying true and false outcomes.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: Answer options mapped to descriptions of each option.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: The question the model should answer.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: Ordered level descriptions, from the low end to the high end.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: The quality or property to score.

noul.title: Noul

true.title: True

false.title: False
false.description: What should count as a no/false outcome.

metadata.description: Vision reasoning variant of NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Nano Omni. 30B A3B hybrid Transformer-Mamba MoE - accepts an image plus a prompt and returns text.

prompt.description: Text prompt to send to the model. English only.
examples: Summarize the key capabilities of a multimodal agent.
prompt.title: Prompt

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Lower is more deterministic.
temperature.title: Temperature

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate.
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

reasoning_mode.description: Whether the model should emit an explicit reasoning trace. `no_think` returns a direct answer; `think` returns chain-of-thought followed by the final answer.
reasoning_mode.title: Reasoning Mode

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt to steer the model. Reasoning behavior is controlled by the separate `reasoning_mode` field.
examples: You are a concise enterprise assistant.
system_prompt.title: System Prompt

image_url.description: URL of the image to reason about. RGB JPEG or PNG.
image_url.title: Image URL

enable_safety_checker.description: Whether to enable the safety checker.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

examples: The image shows a golden retriever puppy sitting on a wooden floor.
output.title: Output

metadata.description: Seed 2.0 Mini is a high-performance multimodal model optimized for low latency and high concurrency. It supports text, image, and video input with 256K context and configurable thinking/reasoning modes.

image_urls.description: URLs of images for visual understanding. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP. A maximum of 6 images is supported. Any additional images will be ignored.
image_urls.title: Image Urls

messages.description: Optional prior conversation history for multi-turn conversations. Pass back the `messages` field from a previous response to provide context. The current `prompt`, `image_urls`, `video_urls`, and `system_prompt` are always appended as the latest user turn.
messages.title: Messages

thinking.description: Controls the model's chain-of-thought reasoning. `enabled` always includes reasoning, `disabled` never includes reasoning, `auto` lets the model decide based on the query.
thinking.title: Thinking

reasoning_effort.description: Controls the depth of reasoning before the model responds. Only applicable when `thinking` is `enabled` or `auto`. `minimal` for immediate response, `low` for faster response with light reasoning, `medium` for balanced speed and depth, `high` for deep analysis of complex issues.
reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling parameter. The model considers tokens with top_p cumulative probability mass. Lower values narrow the token selection.
top_p.title: Top P

temperature.description: Controls randomness in the response. Lower values make output more focused and deterministic, higher values make it more creative.
temperature.title: Temperature

video_urls.description: URLs of videos for video understanding. Supported formats: MP4, MOV. Audio comprehension is not supported. A maximum of 3 videos is supported. Any additional videos will be ignored.
video_urls.title: Video Urls

max_completion_tokens.description: Controls the maximum length of the model's output, including both the model's response and its chain-of-thought content, measured in tokens.
max_completion_tokens.title: Max Completion Tokens

prompt.description: The text prompt or question for the model.
prompt.title: Prompt

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt to guide the model's behavior.
system_prompt.title: System Prompt

messages.description: The full conversation history including the model's response. Pass this back as the `messages` input field to continue the conversation.
messages.title: Messages

reasoning_content.description: The model's chain-of-thought reasoning content. Only present when `thinking` is `enabled` or `auto`.
reasoning_content.title: Reasoning Content

content.description: The content of the message. Can be a string for text-only messages, or a list of content parts for multimodal messages (e.g. with images).
content.title: Content

role.description: The role of the message author.
role.title: Role
